title: Understanding 'Fold' and 'Call' in Texas Hold'em
summaryJa: テキサスホールデムで、フォールド（降りる）とコール（賭け金に合わせる）は基本的なアクションです。これらの用語を理解することで、ゲームの流れがより分かりやすくなります。
segments: Texas Hold'em poker has many important terms. Today we learn about two basic actions: fold and call.
These words describe what a player does during the game. Understanding these terms helps you follow poker games and play better.
Fold means you quit the current hand. You give up your cards and stop playing that round.
You do this when you think you cannot win. When you fold, you lose any money you put in the pot.
But you also stop losing more money. For example: You have weak cards.
The player before you bets a lot of money. You decide to fold.
You do not show your cards. The pot goes to that player.
Call means you match the money that another player bet. You put the same amount of money in the pot.
You do not raise the bet higher. You just match it.
For example: The player next to you bets five dollars. You have okay cards.
You want to stay in the hand. You call.
You put five dollars in the pot. Now you stay in the game.
Both fold and call happen many times in every poker game. Good players know when to fold.
They do not waste money on bad hands. Good players also know when to call.
They call with cards that might win. Learning these two actions is the first step to playing Texas Hold'em well.
